cases.question: What are the officially valid documents (OVD) accepted for individual customer identification under RBI KYC norms?
cases.ground_truth: For individual customers, officially valid documents (OVD) include passport, driving licence, Aadhaar (with consent and masking as applicable), and voter identity card.
cases.answer:
According to the RBI Master Direction, the officially valid documents (OVD) accepted for individual customer identification under KYC norms include: 
1. Passport, 
2. Driving licence, 
3. Aadhaar (with consent and masking as applicable), and 
4. Voter identity card.

RBI Master Direction – Know Your Customer (KYC) Norms (Excerpt)

1. Objective
Regulated entities (REs) shall establish a robust KYC framework to prevent banks from being used for money laundering or terrorist financing activities. Customer identification and verification must be completed before establishing a banking relationship.

2. Customer Due Diligence (CDD)
REs shall obtain and verify the identity of the customer using reliable, independent source documents or data. For individuals, officially valid documents (OVD) include passport, driving licence, Aadhaar (with consent and masking as applicable), and voter identity card.

3. Periodic Updation
KYC records shall be updated at least once every ten years for low-risk customers and at least once every eight years for high-risk customers. REs must maintain records of updation and monitor transactions for unusual patterns.

Internal SOP – Retail KYC Verification Process

Purpose
This SOP defines the standard operating procedure for verifying identity and address of retail banking customers during account opening and periodic review.

Scope
Applicable to all branch staff and digital onboarding teams handling savings, current, and salary accounts.

Procedure
Step 1: Collect the customer application form and self-attested copies of OVD.
Step 2: Verify name, photograph, and address against the original document or through digital KYC as permitted.
Step 3: Capture customer consent for Aadhaar-based verification where used; do not store full Aadhaar number in operational notes.
Step 4: Enter verified details in the core banking system and assign risk category (low, medium, high).
Step 5: Route high-risk profiles to the compliance officer for EDD approval before account activation.

Escalation
Any mismatch in identity details, suspected forged documents, or PEP indicators must be escalated to the branch compliance officer within 24 hours.

3. Periodic Updation
KYC records shall be updated at least once every ten years for low-risk customers and at least once every eight years for high-risk customers. REs must maintain records of updation and monitor transactions for unusual patterns.

4. Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD)
Enhanced due diligence measures are mandatory for high-risk customers, politically exposed persons (PEPs), and non-face-to-face customer onboarding. EDD includes obtaining additional information on source of funds and purpose of relationship.

5. Record Keeping
REs shall maintain KYC documentation and transaction records for at least five years after the business relationship ends or the account is closed, whichever is later.

Credit Policy – Personal Loan Underwriting Guidelines (Excerpt)

Eligibility
Applicants must be resident individuals aged 21–60 years with a minimum net monthly income of INR 25,000 and a credit bureau score of 700 or above unless approved under exception policy.

Documentation
Mandatory documents include identity proof, address proof, income proof (salary slips or ITR), and bank statements for the last six months.

Debt Service Coverage
Total EMI obligations including the proposed loan must not exceed 50% of net monthly income unless compensating factors are documented and approved by credit committee.

Loan Amount
Maximum personal loan amount is capped at 24 times net monthly income or INR 25,00,000, whichever is lower, subject to product-specific limits.

Approval Matrix
Loans up to INR 5,00,000 may be approved by branch credit officer. Amounts above INR 5,00,000 require regional credit head approval. Exceptions require committee review.

Escalation
Any mismatch in identity details, suspected forged documents, or PEP indicators must be escalated to the branch compliance officer within 24 hours.

Records
Maintain verification checklist and audit trail for a minimum of five years.
